meaning:
δόμα, -τος, τό
(δίδωμι), [in LXX for מַתָּנָה, etc. ;]
a gift: Mat.7:11, Luk.11:13, Eph.4:8" (LXX), Php.4:17.†
SYN.: δόσις, δῶρον, δωρεά, δώρημα (AS)

elsewhere.note: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
